purpose: Dense 7B teacher simulator rollouts for 2.064B structured-pruned student distillation
task: pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
teacher_rollout_states: 0..49, one deterministic rollout per official initial state
evaluation_states: 0..49, reported separately for distillation-used 40 and evaluation-only 10
new_training_data_format: one images.npy uint8 [N,256,256,3] and actions.npy float32 [N,7] per successful episode; metadata.json with hashes
training_mix: all 4025 original human frames once and all successful teacher frames once, shuffled together
student_trainable_weights: recovery LoRA rank 8 on language_model q_proj/v_proj; compressed backbone and starting LoRA frozen
validation: original 462 human frames only; no optimizer update on these frames
known_limitations: Fixed official 50 initial states cannot yield unlimited distinct starts
Only ten states are excluded from new distillation data
The original human demonstrations may overlap official initial states; not audited
Success-only teacher rollouts may yield few or biased samples
